api/src/routers/workflows.py.name: Automations
api/src/routers/workflows.py.description: Finds, runs, checks and retires the automations in the workspace, and controls who may run each one.

GET /api/workflows.name: Automations list
GET /api/workflows.description: Lists the automations in the workspace and where each one lives.

GET /api/workflows/usage-stats.name: How automations are used
GET /api/workflows/usage-stats.description: Counts where each automation is referenced, such as in forms, schedules and buttons.

POST /api/workflows/execute.name: Run an automation
POST /api/workflows/execute.description: Starts an automation, an outside data lookup or a one-off script, and returns the run it began.

POST /api/workflows/executions/{executio.name: Cancel a scheduled run
POST /api/workflows/executions/{executio.description: Stops a run that is waiting to start, as long as it has not begun.

POST /api/workflows/validate.name: Check an automation
POST /api/workflows/validate.description: Reads an automation's code and reports problems before it is put to use.

POST /api/workflows/register.name: Add an automation
POST /api/workflows/register.description: Makes an existing piece of code available as an automation.

PATCH /api/workflows/{workflow_id}.name: Update an automation
PATCH /api/workflows/{workflow_id}.description: Changes an automation's name, description or other editable details.

GET /api/workflows/orphaned.name: Missing automations
GET /api/workflows/orphaned.description: Lists automations whose code file has gone missing.

GET /api/workflows/{workflow_id}/compati.name: Possible replacements
GET /api/workflows/{workflow_id}/compati.description: Suggests existing code that could stand in for a missing automation.

POST /api/workflows/{workflow_id}/replac.name: Replace a missing automation
POST /api/workflows/{workflow_id}/replac.description: Points a missing automation at a different code file so it works again.

POST /api/workflows/{workflow_id}/remap.name: Move automation references
POST /api/workflows/{workflow_id}/remap.description: Moves forms, schedules and buttons from one automation over to another.

POST /api/workflows/{workflow_id}/recrea.name: Restore an automation's file
POST /api/workflows/{workflow_id}/recrea.description: Writes the code file back from the copy saved with the automation.

POST /api/workflows/{workflow_id}/deacti.name: Retire a missing automation
POST /api/workflows/{workflow_id}/deacti.description: Switches off an automation whose code has gone for good.

GET /api/workflows/{workflow_id}/roles.name: Who may run it
GET /api/workflows/{workflow_id}/roles.description: Lists the roles allowed to run an automation.

POST /api/workflows/{workflow_id}/roles.name: Allow roles to run it
POST /api/workflows/{workflow_id}/roles.description: Gives one or more roles permission to run an automation.

DELETE /api/workflows/{workflow_id}/role.name: Stop a role running it
DELETE /api/workflows/{workflow_id}/role.description: Takes away one role's permission to run an automation.

GET /api/workflows/{workflow_id}/paramet.name: Workflow input fields
GET /api/workflows/{workflow_id}/paramet.description: Lists the fields a workflow needs before it can be run, without opening the catalog.

GET /api/workflows/{workflow_id}.name: Automation details
GET /api/workflows/{workflow_id}.description: Shows one automation's details, whichever client it belongs to.

GET /api/workflows/{workflow_id}/run-ide.name: Who has run it
GET /api/workflows/{workflow_id}/run-ide.description: Lists the people and services that have run an automation.

GET /api/workflows/{workflow_id}/recomme.name: Suggested access
GET /api/workflows/{workflow_id}/recomme.description: Suggests which roles should be allowed to run an automation, based on how it is used.

DELETE /api/workflows/{workflow_id}.name: Delete an automation
DELETE /api/workflows/{workflow_id}.description: Removes an automation from the workspace and deletes its code.
